title: Bent cantilever with an intermediate lateral support: support reactions

source.work: Bentley Systems, STAAD.Pro Help, Verification Examples (public documentation, docs.bentley.com)
source.edition: STAAD.Pro Help v21 build (pages refer to the STAAD.Pro 2023 sample files), read 2026-11-22
source.location: 'V. Support Reactions for a Simple Frame' (https://docs.bentley.com/LiveContent/web/STAAD.Pro%20Help-v21/en/GUID-1A25B902-67CC-4B2C-A469-37D370E85C34.html)
source.notes: problem statement taken from the vendor page (text and input listing). The page cites: Timoshenko, Strength of Materials, Part I, 3rd ed. 1956, p. 346, problem 2 - NOT opened for this project; no number is taken from it. The page's 'theory' values are recorded as printed; the program's own results are not used.

analysis: Plane problem in the global X-Y plane (Y vertical); the out-of-plane DOFs (uz, rx, ry) of every node are held; in-plane bending about local z. Vertical leg from (0, 0) to (0, 20 in) with a horizontal arm to (10, 20 in); built in at the base, held horizontally at midheight (0, 10 in); 1 kip downward at the end of the arm; A = 10 in^2, I = 100 in^4, E = 3000 ksi. First-order analysis. The page's target is the horizontal reaction (1.5 kip). Reference values: computed here from this statement (verification/derive/vendor_reference.py); the textbook cited by the vendor page was not opened and no number is taken from it.
